title: Grateful Dead Live at Monterey Fairgrounds on 1967-06-18
lineage: SBD > MR > Cass > DAT > ZA2 > CD

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of the historic Monterey Pop set – occasional muddiness and interview inserts, but a fiery Viola Lee Blues plus standout Cold Rain & Snow.
ai_review.review: This recording preserves the legendary June 18‑1967 Monterey Pop performance.  While the soundboard source suffers from occasional mud on Jerry’s solos and some jumbled interview clips, the music shines – especially the ripping Viola Lee Blues, driving Cold Rain and Snow, and the energetic Caution (Do Not Step On The Tracks).  Overall the show is high‑energy and historically significant despite a few technical hiccups.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the performance (4–5 ★) while noting recording flaws (muddy sound, interview splices).  Weighted rating (70 % show + 30 % recording) yields a solid mid‑high score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Occasionally muddy sound, especially on Jerry's solos; some interview excerpts and stage announcements are inserted, causing jumbled content.  A few sound‑system glitches are mentioned, but overall the capture is listenable.

standout_songs: Caution (Do Not Step On The Tracks)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Viola Lee Blues opens, followed by Cold Rain & Snow; some sources have the order reversed, but the energy stays high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar work is amazing and fiery, though a bit muddy on some solos.
band_member_comments.Phil: Was upset about filming rights at Monterey; no specific performance comment.
